# Cyber incident (`cyber-incident` v1)

A cyber-security incident: severity, systems, detection and containment times, data affected.

**Group:** Operational and non-financial risk · **Mnemonic:** `CYBER` · **Identifiers:** `CYBER-…` in `incidentId`

Open one with `CYBER <id>`.

```sutra
sutra: cyber-incident
version: 1
description: "A cyber-security incident: severity, systems, detection and containment times, data affected."
match: { kind: cyber-incident, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: Operational and non-financial risk · Cyber incident, id: $.incidentId }
strip:
  - { label: Incident, bind: $.title }
  - { label: Severity, bind: $.severity, emphasis: true }
  - { label: Detected in (h), bind: $.detectHours, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Contained in (h), bind: $.containHours, fmt: price2 }
  - { label: Records affected, bind: $.recordsAffected, fmt: amount0 }
  - { label: Status, bind: $.status, tone: status }
panels:
  - id: timeline
    kind: ladder
    title: Timeline
    key: F2
    rows: $.timeline
    columns:
      - { label: At, bind: "@.at" }
      - { label: Step, bind: "@.step" }
  - id: systems
    kind: kv
    title: Systems
    area: right
    rows: $.systems
  - { id: built, kind: provenance, title: How this view was built }
  - { id: refs, kind: links, title: Linked entities, code: REFS, area: right }
keys: { F7: "link($.legalEntity, 'legal-entity')", F8: impact, F9: raw }
```

| Records affected | `$.recordsAffected` | `amount0` |
